# Pinup Salon

> A hair salon in West Seattle, Seattle, Washington, established 2008 and owned by Jen Sawyer. Known for color, curl cuts, vintage pin-curl and finger-wave sets, extensions and wedding hair.

## Location and contact
- Address: 4151 Fauntleroy Way SW, Seattle, WA 98126
- Phone: (206) 932-5077
- Email: bookme@pinupsalon.biz
- Book online: https://www.phorest.com/salon/pinupsalon/book

## Hours
- Monday: 10am to 6pm
- Tuesday: 10am to 8pm
- Wednesday: 10am to 8pm
- Thursday: 9am to 7pm
- Friday: 9am to 8pm
- Saturday: 8am to 7:30pm
- Sunday: 9am to 6pm

## Stylists
- Jen (Owner and stylist): Curl cutting, pixies, men’s cuts, lived-in balayage and fashion color. Dry cuts are her favorite technique.
- Denika (Stylist, barber and makeup artist): In the industry since 2010, at Pinup since 2024. Updos, makeup, perms, curly textures and barbering.
- Lindsey (Stylist and extension specialist): Doing hair since 2005, at Pinup since 2011. Certified in Great Lengths and Hair Dreams extensions.
- Bre (Stylist): At Pinup since 2020. Precision cuts, foil placement, color correction, men’s grooming and the classic bob.

## Prices (ranges; the stylist confirms at consultation)
### Haircuts
- Leading Lady Cut: Starting at $80
- Dapper Gentleman Cut: Starting at $45
- Tween / Young Teen Cut: Starting at $38
- Tykes Under 10 Cut: Starting at $27

### Curl Expert services
- Curl Expert Haircut: Starting at $115 (Dry haircut, cleanse, condition and curl set)
- Curl Expert Cleanse, Hydrate and Curl Set: Starting at $55
- Curl Expert Custom Painted Highlights: Starting at $165 (A hand painting technique just for curls)

### Color
- Single process color: Starting at $100
- Color with mini foil: Starting at $135
- Color with partial foil: Starting at $175
- Color with full foil: Starting at $225
- Partial foil highlights: Starting at $125
- The Bora Bora Blonde: Starting at $160 (Full foil highlights)
- Balayage, full head: Starting at $225 (French free hand painting)
- Balayage, partial head: Starting at $185 (Less highlighted, or an ombré effect)
- Give Me the Marilyn: Starting at $150 (All over bleach and tone)
- Rainbow Brights: Starting at $220 (All over bleach and tone with one fashion color)
- Rainbow Brights add-on: Starting at $35 (Per extra color)
- Shadow root: Starting at $50 (Add-on only)
- No More Brass toning: Starting at $75 (For pre-lightened hair)

### Treatments and smoothing
- Olaplex bond multiplier additive: Starting at $20 (Per color bowl)
- Olaplex bond multiplying treatment: Starting at $75
- Deep condition and blowout: Starting at $50
- Shine treatment: Starting at $42 (Added to any service)
- Keratin Complex Express Blowout: Starting at $65 (Lasts 4 to 6 weeks)
- Keratin Complex Smoothing Treatment: Starting at $300 (Lasts 3 to 5 months)
- Keratin Complex Personalized Blowout: Starting at $300 (Lasts 3 to 4 months)

### Styling, vintage and bridal
- Shampoo and style: Starting at $65
- Up-do or roller set: Starting at $85
- The Vintage Look: Starting at $100 (Classic fingerwave or pin-curl set and style)
- Wed Head: Starting at $250 (Wedding hair, including a 1 hour trial run in advance)
- On-site bridal hair or makeup: Starting at $325
- On-site photo shoot hair and makeup: Starting at $150 (Per hour, plus travel)

### Texture
- Let's Get It Straight: Starting at $120 (Cream relaxer)
- Guys and Girls Love Curls: Starting at $160 (Perm, beach or texture wave)
- Bleached Hair Loves Curls Too: Starting at $200 (Perm safe for previously bleached hair)

### Extensions
- Great Lengths or Hair Dreams keratin bonds: At consultation
- Hot Heads or Great Lengths tape-ins: At consultation
- Silicone beaded or I-tip extensions: At consultation
- Weave-in or glue-in extensions: At consultation
- Braidless sew-in extensions: At consultation
- Braided sew-in, partial: Starting at $200 (Hair provided by client)
- Braided sew-in, full: Starting at $320 (Hair provided by client)

### Waxing and makeup

- Brow tint: Starting at $26

## Service and area pages
- [Hair Extensions in Seattle | Great Lengths and Hair Dreams | Pinup Salon](https://pinupsalonseattle.com/hair-extensions-seattle/): Hair extensions in West Seattle from Lindsey, certified in Great Lengths and Hair Dreams. Keratin bonds, tape-ins, I-tips and sew-ins, matched at a consultation.
- [Balayage in West Seattle | Lived-In Color | Pinup Salon](https://pinupsalonseattle.com/balayage-seattle/): Balayage at Pinup Salon in West Seattle: French free-hand painting, partial balayage for a softer or ombré look, and hand-painted highlights made for curls.
- [Keratin Treatment in Seattle | Keratin Complex | Pinup Salon](https://pinupsalonseattle.com/keratin-treatment-seattle/): Keratin Complex smoothing at Pinup Salon in West Seattle. The Express Blowout lasts 4 to 6 weeks and the full Smoothing Treatment lasts 3 to 5 months.
- [Wedding Hair and Makeup in Seattle | Bridal Trials | Pinup Salon](https://pinupsalonseattle.com/wedding-hair-seattle/): Wedding hair and makeup from Pinup Salon in West Seattle. Wed Head includes a one hour trial run, and on-site bridal hair or makeup is available.
- [Finger Waves, Pin Curls and Victory Rolls in Seattle | Pinup Salon](https://pinupsalonseattle.com/vintage-hair-seattle/): Vintage hair in Seattle from the salon named for the 1940s pinup look: finger waves, pin-curl sets, victory rolls and roller sets in West Seattle.
- [Hair Salon Near Burien, WA | Pinup Salon in West Seattle](https://pinupsalonseattle.com/hair-salon-near-burien/): Looking for a hair salon near Burien? Pinup Salon is in West Seattle, about 10.6 miles north of Burien Town Square, with curl cuts, color, extensions and vintage styling.

- [Thinking about a perm in Seattle? Pinup in West Seattle has a perm specialist.](https://pinupsalonseattle.com/blog/perm-seattle/): Pinup Salon in West Seattle does perms, beach waves and texture waves, including a perm made for hair that is already bleached. Denika is the salon’s perm specialist.
